# MedAorticX Healthtek

> MedAorticX Healthtek is a healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) company dedicated to helping healthcare providers simplify complex revenue processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen financial performance.

## About

MedAorticX Healthtek provides end-to-end revenue cycle management solutions for hospitals, specialty clinics, and provider groups. We combine deep healthcare domain expertise with modern technology to optimize every stage of the revenue cycle — from patient registration and medical coding to claims management and denial resolution.

## Services

- **Medical Coding**: Specialty-specific coding with 99.8% accuracy rates, covering ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS code assignment.
- **Medical Billing**: Clean claim submission, charge entry, charge review, and payment posting.
- **Claims Management**: End-to-end claims lifecycle management, from submission to follow-up and resolution.
- **Denial Management**: Root-cause analysis of denied claims, swift appeals, and prevention strategies.
- **Accounts Receivable (AR) Management**: Systematic follow-up on outstanding balances to accelerate collections.
- **Charge Review & Audit**: Pre-billing audits to catch errors and ensure coding compliance.
- **Quality & Compliance Support**: HIPAA-compliant processes aligned with payer and regulatory requirements.

## Solutions

### Hospitals & Health Systems
Centralized medical coding and billing oversight across departments, claims management and denial resolution with root-cause analysis, and compliance support aligned with regulatory requirements.

### Specialty Clinics & Practices
Specialty-specific medical coding, eligibility and benefits verification, charge entry and clean claim submission, and denial management tailored per specialty.

### Provider Groups & MSOs
Group-wide revenue cycle support and performance tracking, standardized coding and billing workflows, payment posting reconciliation, and scalable support.
